Measurements: /tmp/claude-0/rater18B/ms.py (box mean, B/R, L p10/p50/p90, hf = std of L minus 5 px box blur, bright = fraction of L > 1.5 x median), blob counts inline (bright connected blobs per 1000 px, median / p90 size). Crops: /tmp/claude-0/rater18B/z15.png (y_47300 s2/s3 vs q15 s2/s3 at x0.62), z4.png (y_47306 middle seat vs e4 middle seat). Lighting and QA camera placement noted, not scored.

issues.title: Petal fleck too small and faint at row distance (regression from the finer cores)
issues.evidence: q15 s2/s4 downsampled x0.62 to y_47300 scale vs y_47300 s2/s4: blob count 51/49 vs 49/50 per 1000 px (fine) but median size 1 px vs 3 px, p90 3 vs 6 px; p90/p50 1.38-1.48 vs 1.77; bright 0.07-0.09 vs 0.15; hf 12.5-13.7 vs 26-29 (w17: 1.59 / 0.13). z15.png: photo flecks are crisp near-white specks, render flecks soft pale-blue dots that the mip chain averages away. Ground colour is right (B/R 2.34-2.37 vs 2.25-2.33, L50 57-58 vs 54-61): do not change the ground.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py tex_y_fleck: keep the count and the elongated shape, but make each fleck ~1.6x the area (length +30 %, width +25 %, i.e. ~0.6-0.8 cm long) and its core near-white (L +20 %, tint toward #c8d2ec), so area fraction returns to ~0.14-0.16; target q15 p90/p50 ~1.7, bright ~0.15.

issues.title: Headrest cover near-black at close / oblique range; no leather sheen or hem fold
issues.evidence: e4 cover #1e2237 L50 41 vs y_47306 #475273 L50 86; q16 near cover #1c2139 L50 35 p90/p50 1.70 vs y_47301 #3a3e5d L50 56 p90/p50 2.45; y_47303 oblique covers slate #67749a L50 156. Head-on q15 #2b304a L50 56 vs 42-53 is fine, so the w18 'darker matte' change is right head-on but too matte: the photo cover is a slate grey-blue leather whose brightness rises with grazing angle. z4.png: photo shows a creased hem fold and a small logo at the lower right; render flat.
issues.fix: SEATMAT yCover: keep base ~#2e3452, lower roughness 0.62 -> ~0.40 and add a Fresnel / sheen term so grazing views reach L ~80-150; add the 1 cm folded hem band with a slightly lighter edge along the bottom.
